description: This trail follows the edge of "The Precipice", with basalt cliffs and pillars producing steep drops of greater than 30m. It provides beautiful viewscapes and leads to Hotnarko Falls which is only 50m from the parking area. The best view of the waterfalls can be reached by following a trail to the north along the edge of the precipice. Because of the large drop-off that is not protected by a barrier, children and pets should be monitored closely.
directions:
From Williams Lake travel west on Hwy 20 for about 316 km to the community of Anahim Lake. Stay on highway 20 instead of going into the community and, after passing the turnoff to the Anahim Lake Airport, continue west along the highway (which soon turns to gravel) for about 16 km. Turn left onto the Beeftrail Road. Travel about 6.5 km south along the Beeftrail Road and then turn right onto the Hotnarko Road. From here, the trailhead and parking area for the Precipice Rimrock (Hotnarko Falls) Trail is reached in another 3.5 km.

An alternate route to reach the trailhead is also possible. Shortly after passing the turnoff to the Anahim Lake Airport along Highway 20, turn left onto the Kappan Mountain Road. Follow for 5 km to a 4-way intersection with the Beeftrail Road. Turn right onto the Beeftrail Road and travel approximately 11.7 km and turn left onto Hotnarko Road (shortly after you pass the yellow 19 km marker). Follow the Hotnarko Road for about 3.5 km to the parking area at the trailhead.
